title: Connect to MyCollections
description: Open the pairing link the API printed when it started — on a first run it opens by itself. Or paste the link, or the API token, below.
token_placeholder: Paste the API token or pairing link here
no_persistence_notice: This browser will not let MyCollections remember your token, so you will need to paste it again each time you open the app here.
pairing_rejected: That pairing link has expired or was already used. Restart the API for a new one, or paste the API token below.
pairing_unreachable: Could not reach the API to pair this browser. Make sure it is running, then open the link again.
